Pip doesn't want to go to sleep — what if he misses something good while his eyes are closed? #SleepyMeadowStories Oona the owl helps him see that the meadow waits patiently for him, and that dreams might just be the best part of all.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

#BedtimeStory #ToddlerSleepHelp #DreamyBedtime

settings.title: The Bunny Who Didn't Want to Miss Anything | A Sleepy Meadow Bedtime Story
